provenance.instrument: Montgomery Township Code Chapter 230 Zoning (readopted 2-12-2007 by Ord. No. 06-211Z, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: 230-149 (accessory uses) carries amendments to Ord. No. 25-350Z (9-22-2025). eCode360 New Laws showed 0 items on 2026-11-14.
provenance.code_current_through_note: No 'legislation through' date read. Newest amendment seen in 230-149: Ord. No. 25-350Z (9-22-2025). New Laws: none.
checks: One 'accessory family dwelling' is permitted with a single-family detached house, 'as a residence by family members or a family caregiver' (230-149C)
It must be part of the house, with an internal connection to it. At most 25% of the house's total floor area, not counting any garage (230-149C(5), (6))

The house keeps the look of a single-family house with one front entrance. Side or rear entrances only. No outside stair on the front. No parking in the front yard beyond three spaces in the driveway (230-149C(2), (3))
No rental, and no income use. The owner records a deed restriction in favor of the Township (230-149C(9))
Registered with the Zoning Officer for a fee. The registration ends when the property is sold. A new owner may register again (230-149C(8))
One parking space more than the house needs (230-149C(7))
Any on-lot septic system must be recertified if sewage flows increase (230-149C(1))
Allowed where a single-family detached house is a permitted use: R-1, R-2, R-3, R-3A, R-3B (age-qualified housing), R-5 and R-6. Nonresidential districts use Appendix Table 230-A, which was not read
230-149C(3) calls the unit 'the conversion'. A new addition built for the unit may be read differently. Ask the zoning officer
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Montgomery Township (montgomerytwp.org). Read on eCode360 in a browser, one section print view at a time. District use lists read for R-1, R-2, R-3, R-3A, R-3B, R-5, R-6 and C. C permits the uses in Appendix Table 230-A (an attachment, not opened). Dimensional rules read for R-1 and R-2.

term.note: 'Accessory family dwelling. One accessory dwelling unit to a single-family detached dwelling shall be permitted as a residence by family members or a family caregiver.'

status.note: Permitted with a single-family detached house, for family members or a family caregiver. No rental (230-149C(9)(c)).

scope_districts.note: Districts whose use lists permit a single-family detached dwelling by right, with accessory uses customarily incidental to it. 230-149C itself names no district.

status_outside.note: The C district (and other nonresidential districts) permit uses listed in Appendix Table 230-A, an attachment that was not opened. Whether a house, and so this unit, is permitted there was not confirmed. Ask the zoning officer.

path.note: 'shall be permitted'. R-1 lists 'Accessory use on the same lot with and customarily incidental to any of the foregoing uses' (230-26G). R-2 adds 'subject to the provisions of Article XXI, § 230-149 herein' (230-31G). R-3, R-3A, R-3B, R-5 and R-6 list accessory uses customarily incidental to the permitted dwellings. Registration with the Zoning Officer (230-149C(8)).

fallback_path.note: A unit that fails 230-149C needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

value.name: Living quarters for a household caretaker
value.conditions: Living quarters for a household caretaker within the dwelling, listed as a use accessory to a dwelling.
value.note: The code does not say whether these quarters may be a separate dwelling unit with its own kitchen.

zoning_districts.note: 230-149C names no district. These are the districts whose use lists permit a single-family detached dwelling. In R-3B the dwellings are age-qualified (230-53.2A(1), 230-53.9).

existing_structure_only.note: 'shall be part of the principal residence'. 230-149C(3) speaks of 'The conversion', which suggests space inside an existing house, but no rule requires the space to exist already. Ask the zoning officer.

value.condition: Only as a residence by family members or a family caregiver. No rental, no income use.

Part of the house with an internal connection. One front entrance, others on the side or rear. No outside stair on the front. No front-yard parking beyond three spaces in the driveway. Separate cooking and sanitary facilities.
Registration with the Zoning Officer, ending at sale. A recorded deed restriction in favor of the Township describing the unit.
Any on-lot septic system must be recertified if sewage flows will increase.

types_allowed.note: 'shall be part of the principal residence. An internal connection shall be provided'. An addition joined inside to the house is read as part of the residence. A detached or garage unit is not.

max_share_of_house.note: 'shall occupy no more than 25% of the total floor area of the principal residence, not including any garage.'

max_height_ft.note: Part of the house. No ADU height.

owner_occupancy.note: No owner-occupancy rule. The record owner grants the deed restriction.

occupancy.value: Family members or a family caregiver. No rental.

max_adus.note: 'One accessory dwelling unit to a single-family detached dwelling'.

short_term_rental_banned.note: 'The rental of an accessory family dwelling shall not be permitted, nor shall it be used in any way as an income property.'

spaces_required.note: 'The required off-street parking for the principal dwelling plus one additional off-street parking space for the accessory family dwelling shall be provided.'

new_connection_required.note: Septic recertification. No rule on a separate connection.

principal_max_height_ft.note: 'For any dwelling: 35 feet, not exceeding 2 1/2 stories.'
